Check whether the prior translation work, the preliminary system and the later edition denote the same work.
challenge.results: The project combined deduction with natural-language work and used French. The manuscript describes Q-systems as a predecessor and distinguishes the application-led preliminary Prolog from the 1973 programming-language development. These distinctions preserve the claim's origins scope. The inspected passages yielded no material contrary evidence for the authors' account of that project.
